world_port_index: Holds ports and harbors (one row per port) with keys/indexes like index_number, region_number, port_name, country and measures/attributes including port_latitude, port_longitude, publication_number, chart_number, harbor_size, harbor_type, shelter_afforded, entry_tide, entry_swell, entry_ice, entry_other, overhead_limit, channel_depth, anchorage_depth, cargo_pier_depth, cargo_oil_depth, tide_range, max_vessel_size, good_holding_ground, turning_area, port_of_entry, us_representative, ETA/operational flags (eta_message_required), pilot_required, pilot_available, pilot_local_assist, pilot_advised, tug_salvage, tug_assist, quarantine_procedures_required, quarantine_sscc_cert_required, quarantine_other, and communications fields comms_phone, comms_fax, comms_radio, comms_vhf.
coastline: Holds coastline geometry (one row per coastline feature) with name and coastline_geom as the geometry and partitioning/cluster keys PARTITION and CLUSTER.
csa: Holds combined statistical areas (one row per CSA) with geo_id and csa_code as identifiers and columns name, lsad_name, msa_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom and csa_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
railways: Holds railway features (one row per railway feature) with geo_id and full_name as identifiers, mtfcc_feature_class_code, railway_geom as geometry, and PARTITION and CLUSTER.
cbsa: Holds core-based statistical areas (one row per CBSA) with geo_id, csa_geo_id, cbsa_fips_code and name, lsad_name, lsad_code, msa_indicator, mtfcc_feature_class_code; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom and cbsa_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
adjacent_counties: Holds adjacency lists for counties (one row per county) with county, state, county_fips_code and neighbor lists in neighbors, neighbors_state, neighbors_fips_code.
counties: Holds county polygons/records (one row per county) with geo_id, state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, county_name, lsad_name, lsad_code, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, csa_fips_code, cbsa_fips_code, met_div_fips_code, functional_status; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom and county_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
adjacent_states: Holds adjacency lists for states (one row per state) with state, state_name, state_fips_code and neighbor lists in neighbors_state and neighbors_fips_code.
metropolitan_divisions: Holds metropolitan division geometries (one row per metdiv) with geo_id, csa_code, cbsa_code, metdiv_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom and metdiv_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
states: Holds state polygons/records (one row per state) with geo_id, region_code, division_code, state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state, state_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom and state_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
cnecta: Holds combined NECTA areas (one row per CNECTA) with geo_id, cnecta_fips_code, name, name_lsad, lsad, mtfcc_feature_class_code; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon and cnecta_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
congress_district_<N>: Holds congressional districts (one row per district) with geo_id, state_fips_code, district_fips_code, lsad_name, lsad_code, congress_session, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status; spatial/measures include area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom and district_geom, plus PARTITION and CLUSTER.
zip_codes: Holds ZIP Code geographic records, one row per zip_code (zip_code) with place and jurisdiction identifiers (city, county, state_fips_code, state_code, state_name), classification codes (fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status), land/water areas in meters (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point coordinates and geometry (internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, internal_point_geom), full ZIP geometry (zip_code_geom), and storage/partition metadata (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
nws_forecast_regions: Holds National Weather Service forecast region definitions, one row per region identified by state and cwa (state, cwa) with time zone and area identifiers (time_zone, fe_area, zone, state_zone), human names (name, shortname), representative coordinates (lon, lat) and the region geometry (shape_geometry).
urban_areas: Holds urban area geography, one row per urban area (geo_id, urban_area_code) with names and classification (name, lsad_name, area_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, type, functional_status), land/water areas in meters (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point coordinates and geometry (internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom), full urban area geometry (urban_area_geom), and storage/partition metadata (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
national_outline: Holds national outline geometry, one row per outline feature (geo_id, aff_geo_id) with the feature name (name) and the U.S. outline geometry (us_outline_geom).
hurricanes: Holds hurricane/track observations, one row per reported observation (sid, season, number) with identifiers and classification (basin, subbasin, name, iso_time, nature, track_type, iflag), position and distance to land (latitude, longitude, dist2land, landfall), agency wind/pressure fields (wmo_wind, wmo_pressure, wmo_agency; usa_wind, usa_pressure, usa_agency, usa_status, usa_record), standardized USA-specific metrics and radii (usa_sshs, usa_r34_ne, usa_r34_se, usa_r34_sw, usa_r34_nw, usa_r50_ne, usa_r50_se, usa_r50_sw, usa_r50_nw, usa_r64_ne, usa_r64_se, usa_r64_sw, usa_r64_nw), and size indices (usa_poci, usa_roci, usa_rmw, usa_latitude, usa_longitude).
